metadata.description: Fourteen-item measure of problematic or compulsive internet use.
metadata.intended_use: Research screening and behavioral-health studies of problematic internet use.
metadata.name_origin: Compulsive Internet Use Scale, abbreviated CIUS.
metadata.development_history: The German adolescent version was evaluated in a validation study; adult language-invariance evidence is documented separately in the literature.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Items cover loss of control, preoccupation, withdrawal-like experiences, conflict, and negative consequences.
metadata.interpretation_notes: A screening score is not a diagnosis; do not transfer adolescent cutoffs or translation evidence automatically to adults.

versions.source_citation: Meerkerk et al. (2009). The Compulsive Internet Use Scale.

source_documents.title: German adolescent CIUS validation
source_documents.license_name: Metadata reference; exact reuse terms require source review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only bibliographic and discovery metadata is stored. Questionnaire wording and forms are not included until exact edition, language, and reuse terms are verified.
